A FEW WAYS IN

About this experiment

Columns of invented glyphs fall in two depths. Move your cursor, or touch on a phone, to part the nearby columns; glyphs under the lens light up in a second color. Arrow keys move the lens, dragging sideways slants the rain, and scroll or + − changes the glyph size. Space or Change the script cycles four invented alphabets: stem runes, circuit marks, pinhole code and shard angles. R or New alphabet generates a fresh seeded alphabet and column pattern; Color cycles five palettes. Fall speed and Columns are adjustable. P pauses; reduced motion starts paused. Hide controls for an uninterrupted view. Save frame exports PNG. Every glyph is a procedurally generated vector stroke pattern, not a font character.
